wstep: There is no recipe here for saffron milk caps (rydze) fried in clarified butter and sealed in jars under a layer of fat.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Drying and cooking do not destroy the toxins of poisonous mushrooms, and only an expert can tell edible species from poisonous ones.

akapity: NCHFP says: do not can wild mushrooms.
Botulism cases have been linked to mushrooms covered in oil: in the USA in 1998, to home-prepared mushrooms in oil, and in the United Kingdom, to two cases of mushrooms in oil.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for mushrooms sealed in jars under fat from a checked source.
NCHFP says that mushrooms can be frozen after they are steamed or heated in fat in a fry pan.
